conversation.requestZip: Provide a local project ZIP. After upload, I’ll identify the framework, entry point, and migration boundaries, then ask you to confirm the migration method before making changes.
conversation.zipHint: Only local ZIP files are supported, up to {{size}}. The migration environment is retained for 1 hour after creation.
conversation.initializing: Initializing the migration workspace and checking AgentKit CLI, Codex, and migration capabilities. The project will upload automatically when the environment is ready.
conversation.uploadThenAnalyze: Read-only analysis will start automatically after the ZIP upload completes.
conversation.analyzing: Codex is identifying the framework, entry point, and migration boundaries. No migration changes are being made.
conversation.migrationLocked: Attachments and migration settings cannot be changed while migration is running. Wait for the task to finish or stop it.
conversation.analysisPaused: Read-only analysis is paused. Answer only the questions below. After submission, analysis will continue in the same environment without starting the migration.
conversation.analysisComplete: Read-only analysis is complete. Review the recommendation and confirm the final migration method.
conversation.awaitingUpload: The migration environment is ready. Select the local ZIP again to continue uploading.
conversation.expiredDescription: Migration content and output can no longer be previewed, downloaded, or deployed. If the Runtime deployment completed, return to the Agents page to continue using it.
conversation.unsupportedTitle: This ZIP cannot be migrated yet
conversation.unsupportedHint: Update the project as instructed, then create a new migration and upload it again.
conversation.cancelled: This migration was stopped. Create a new migration and upload the project again.

advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.standardDescription: Uses 3 dimensions by default: semantic fidelity, output constraints, and workflow/tool fidelity.
advanced.customDescription: Select one or more dimensions based on business risk.
advanced.lockedDescription: The evaluation method and dimensions cannot change after upload starts.

dimensionDescription.semantic_fidelity: Checks whether intent, conclusions, and key facts remain consistent.
dimensionDescription.output_contract: Checks required fields, structure, language, and formatting constraints.
dimensionDescription.workflow_tool_fidelity: Checks observable workflow branches and tool-driven behavior.
dimensionDescription.context_memory_fidelity: Checks supported multi-turn context and memory behavior.
dimensionDescription.boundary_error_fidelity: Checks invalid input, missing information, and dependency failures.
dimensionDescription.safety_refusal_fidelity: Checks existing authorization, refusal, and sensitive-data boundaries.
